description: The paper's router: boundary p from the cosine distance of consecutive states (start semantics, one-chunk lookahead).
Causal end-of-chunk boundary logit from an MLP on the encoder state (blog semantics, EXP-001); the router of every later arm.
Alternative end-of-chunk guesses; indistinguishable from end_mlp within seed noise.

Select the top 1/N positions by rank of the batch-standardized fp32 logit (trimmed mean/std since EXP-023); pins compression exactly, makes the ratio loss inert, immune to uniform shifts. EXP-014's p-space version collapsed; EXP-021's median/MAD version diverged.
Sharper STE/EMA confidences from the standardized score margin.

Each chunk's byte content hashed by n_hash hashes into FLOP-free embedding tables added to the chunk vector: a token table for the learned tokenizer. Worthless at (3,3) character pairs, decisive at word scale.
Trains the main network to predict the next chunk's bucket (1024 negatives, training only, +1.6% FLOPs). Harmful at (3,3), part of every word-scale arm; does not reach the router unless chunk_ste.
BLT-style hashed byte n-gram embeddings (FLOP-free) added to the byte stage; parameter-matches BPE's table and closes ~40% of the gap.
For the first router_prior_frac of training the stage-0 router's logit is also trained (BCE, weight -> 0) toward 'a chunk ends at every whitespace byte'; then released.
Chunk vectors entering the main network are multiplied by STE(confidence), so chunk-level losses train the router independently of the decoder's adoption.
The residual bypass into each decoder is scaled by the router's mean margin 2*mean|p-0.5|, so it opens only once the tokenizer is decided.

Second decoder + head pass on the bypass alone; each byte's gain is credited to its chunk, standardized, and the router's decisions are trained by REINFORCE on that advantage (+~15% compute at tiny scale).
Boundary logit from the last k bytes only, so the same string is always cut the same way.
Share of the stage-0 logit variance not explained by the last n bytes (1 - R^2 of the hashed n-gram group means); scale-free since the second launch.
Mean binary entropy of boundary probabilities, pushing toward confident decisions; amplifies the all-flip mode.
Training-time probability of zeroing a whole segment's residual path so the decoder must rely on the hierarchy; inflates compression by 31%.
Residual projection initialized to identity instead of zero; the bypass is strong from step 0 and the hierarchy is never used.
Residual path into each decoder scaled from 0 to 1 over the first fraction of training; neutral at (3,3), harmful at word scale (vp_rwarm).
Auxiliary next-byte CE on the stage-0 dechunked main-network output alone; +0.01 on the fixed hourglass, collapsed compression with the learned router.
Head on the innermost main network's output predicting the first k bytes of the next chunk (bypasses dechunker, residual and decoder). Spec only.
Chunk vector = learned summary (mean or attention pooling) of the encoder states within the chunk plus the boundary state.
Paper's select-and-plug-back with EMA smoothing; 'repeat' (no smoothing) was the paper_nosmooth ablation (neutral).
Paper's compression ratio loss; at alpha 0.03 it cannot hold the budget (max penalty ~0.09 nats), alpha 1.0 holds it. Inert under rank decisions.
Hard boundaries at word starts/ends or every N bytes, for diagnosis of routing vs capacity.
Paper App. C modulation (stage 0 at ~3.5x base, main at 0.72x); removing them is neutral at tiny scale.
modded-nanogpt record-18 Muon on hidden 2-D matrices, Adam on embeddings/heads/norms/router. Ladder optimizer; on the tiny prior H-Net 1.631 vs AdamW 1.635.
Chunkwise gated delta-rule linear attention replacing the outer Mamba-2; crashed in EXP-010 (channel constraint) and failed again in EXP-026 (rc=1).
Outer Mamba-2 replaced by windowed softmax attention (window 256); 1.742 vs 1.635 on the prior model.

description: Implemented and FLOPs-matched with tests; never trained (EXP-005 not launched).
arXiv 2603.15031 block-wise attention over earlier layer outputs; wired into configs and FLOPs, never trained.
Eager, index-clamped, row-chunked BlockMask for ragged packed lengths; fixed the CUDA illegal-memory-access crashes and the [H,T,T] OOM.
val bpb with each stage's main network silenced; val/zero_main_s0_bpb - val/bpb = the hierarchy's contribution.
Holds data, bytes/step, FLOPs/byte (±2%), optimizer and eval equal across arms; realized FLOPs from logged compression flagged above 2%.
Bytes/chunk, singleton share, boundaries on word boundaries, per-word consistency and top chunks of a trained router vs the whitespace tokenizer.
Autograd of each objective term against each parameter group at init and after N SGD steps, with mechanism metrics and plain-language warnings.
Causality and packing equivalence for the paper router, end_mlp + rank decisions and the chunk vocabulary (train-mode rank decisions couple the batch; eval mode is causal).
